description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git' providing an interface to Git version control system, including methods for executing commands, handling repositories, configuration, credentials, and internal utilities.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class for errors from executing external Git commands.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object based on provided options or directory.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command, returning output as string or array.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns the first line of output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command and returns a pipe to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command and returns a pipe for input.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe from command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Runs a command with bidirectional pipes.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes and checks command success.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git executables.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Returns timezone offset from GMT.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle with specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts user for input, with support for askpass programs.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns subdirectory inside working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes working copy subdirectory.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration variable.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves boolean configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves path configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves integer configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves config keys matching regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Checks if color should be used for a named operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color escape sequence for a slot.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Gets refs from remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses ident info (author/committer).

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns person part of ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of a file considering type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Hashes a file and inserts it into object database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs blob content to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts port name or number to numeric port.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Runs git credential command for given credentials and operation.
